question: Should OpenClaw add a model-facing parent-only sub-agent send contract, and should that contract be a dedicated sessions_send_parent tool or a reserved sessionKey:"parent" selector on sessions_send?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape changes session authorization and model-facing tool semantics, so automation should not choose the boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Dedicated Parent-Only Contract
options.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from active spawn metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and auto-forwarded targets.

options.title: Reserve sessionKey:"parent"
options.body: Keep one sessions_send tool but make parent a special trusted selector rather than a literal user-supplied session key.

options.title: Decline Native Mid-Run Sends
options.body: Keep child-originated mid-run sends unsupported and document completion handoff, sessions_yield, or explicit trusted operator opt-ins as the supported paths.

recommendation.title: Add Dedicated Parent-Only Contract
recommendation.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from active spawn metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and auto-forwarded targets.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is most directly connected to recent sessions_send, session resolution, and docs contract history for the requested API shape.
